# report-studio

**The reference app: a Next.js frontend on the MGPL client SDK, with the kits as its backend.**

Copy its patterns into any MGPL app: one backend route, a fully custom UI, live previews, PDF download.

[![App](https://img.shields.io/badge/type-reference%20app-14264A)](#)
[![Next.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/Next.js-16-14264A?logo=next.js&logoColor=white)](#)
[![React](https://img.shields.io/badge/React-19-14264A?logo=react&logoColor=white)](#)

### The split, in one picture

```
src/app/api/mgpl/[...path]/route.ts   ← BACKEND (the only kit import)
src/app/**/page.tsx                    ← FRONTEND (client SDK only)
src/lib/mgpl.ts                        ← createMgplClient()
```

`next build` makes every page **static**; only `/api/mgpl/*` runs on the server. Point
`NEXT_PUBLIC_MGPL_API` at another origin and the frontend deploys on its own.
</td>
</tr>
</table>

## Pages and routes

| Path | What |
|---|---|
| `/` | report gallery: design + variant toggles, print, open/download PDF |
| `/new` | **create a report**: patient + tests form generated from the catalog, live preview (`/new?demo` prefills) |
| `/invoice` | sample invoices |
| `/letterhead` | blank stationery (print borderless) |
| `/designs/index.html` | the six design options the Navy Sidebar was chosen from |
| `/api/mgpl/*` | the backend: `createMgplApi()` from invoice-kit (reports + invoices + assets) |

## Run it

```bash
npm install
npm run dev            # http://localhost:3000
```

The kits come from GitHub Packages. Add `.npmrc` (`@mgpl-diagnostics:registry=https://npm.pkg.github.com`) and a
token with `read:packages`. Inside the local MGPL workspace they are linked from the sibling folders instead.

### Environment

| Variable | Side | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `MGPL_SIGNATURE_HEADER_FILE` / `MGPL_SIGNATURE_NONHEADER_FILE` | backend | path to the **real signature images**. Keep them outside git; the repo only ships a placeholder. |
| `NEXT_PUBLIC_MGPL_API` | frontend | backend URL if it runs elsewhere (default `/api/mgpl`) |

Put them in `.env.local` (git-ignored).

## Use these patterns in your own app

1. **Backend:** copy [`src/app/api/mgpl/[...path]/route.ts`](src/app/api/mgpl/%5B...path%5D/route.ts), or mount the
   [Fastify plugin](https://github.com/mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit#mount-it-anywhere) in a separate server.
2. **Frontend:** `npm i @mgpl-diagnostics/client`, create one client ([`src/lib/mgpl.ts`](src/lib/mgpl.ts)) and build your UI.
   [`src/app/new/page.tsx`](src/app/new/page.tsx) shows a complete form → preview → PDF flow.
3. **Types:** [`src/contract-check.ts`](src/contract-check.ts) fails `npm run typecheck` if the client and the kits ever disagree.

## Scripts

`dev` · `build` · `start` · `typecheck` · `designs` (regenerates `public/designs/`)

See [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the rules (no rendering logic here; fix it in the kits).

## Part of MGPL Diagnostics

| Repo | Side | |
|---|---|---|
| [report-kit](https://github.com/mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit) | backend | reports, letterhead, templates |
| [invoice-kit](https://github.com/mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit) | backend | patient invoices + combined API |
| [client](https://github.com/mgpl-diagnostics/client) | frontend | headless SDK, zero dependencies |
| **report-studio** | app | Next.js reference app |

## File: AGENTS.md

# AGENTS.md — report-studio

The reference Next.js 16 app (App Router, Turbopack, React 19) for MGPL Diagnostics. It demonstrates
the intended architecture:

- **Backend:** exactly one route, `src/app/api/mgpl/[...path]/route.ts`, which mounts `createMgplApi()`
  from invoice-kit. This is the **only** file that imports a backend kit (plus `src/contract-check.ts`, types only).
- **Frontend:** every page is a client component that uses `@mgpl-diagnostics/client` (and its unstyled
  React hooks). All UI and CSS belong to this app (`src/app/globals.css`, `src/components/`).

Rendering bugs belong in the kits, not here.

## Map

```
src/app/api/mgpl/[...path]/route.ts   backend (createMgplApi, samples enabled for the demo)
src/lib/mgpl.ts                       the client (NEXT_PUBLIC_MGPL_API or "/api/mgpl")
src/app/page.tsx                      report gallery
src/app/new/page.tsx                  result-entry form from GET /templates + live preview (?demo prefills)
src/app/invoice/page.tsx              invoice gallery
src/app/letterhead/page.tsx           blank stationery
src/components/                       Nav, Segmented, pdf-actions (popup-safe open / download)
src/contract-check.ts                 compile-time check: client types ⇄ kit types
public/designs/                       static design-option pages (scripts/design-gallery.tsx)
```

## Rules

- Before using a Next.js API, check `node_modules/next/dist/docs/`. This Next version may differ
  from your training data.
- Never import a kit from a page or component. Use the client.
- Keep `export const runtime = "nodejs"` on the API route.
- Real signatures: `MGPL_SIGNATURE_HEADER_FILE` / `MGPL_SIGNATURE_NONHEADER_FILE` in `.env.local`
  (git-ignored), pointing outside the repo. Never commit signature images.
- After changes: `npm run typecheck` (includes the contract check) and `npm run build`. The build must show
  every page as static and only `/api/mgpl/[...path]` as dynamic.

## Licence

All rights reserved (see LICENSE).

## File: src/app/api/mgpl/[...path]/route.ts

```ts
// BACKEND — the only place this app touches the MGPL kits. Everything under /api/mgpl/* is served
// by createMgplApi(): templates, reports, invoices, letterhead, fonts/images. The pages call it
// through @mgpl-diagnostics/client, exactly as a separate frontend app (or another domain) would.
import { createMgplApi } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit";

export const runtime = "nodejs";

const api = createMgplApi({
  basePath: "/api/mgpl",
  samples: true, // demo data for the preview pages; leave off in production
});

export { api as GET, api as POST, api as OPTIONS };
```


---

## File: src/lib/mgpl.ts

```ts
// FRONTEND — one shared client. Point baseUrl at another origin to use a separate backend.
import { createMgplClient } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/client";

export const mgpl = createMgplClient({ baseUrl: process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_MGPL_API ?? "/api/mgpl" });
```

## File: src/contract-check.ts

```ts
// Compile-time check that the client's contract types match what the backend kits accept/return.
// `npm run typecheck` fails here if the client and the kits drift apart.
import type * as C from "@mgpl-diagnostics/client";
import type * as I from "@mgpl-diagnostics/invoice-kit";
import type * as K from "@mgpl-diagnostics/report-kit";

type Assert<T extends true> = T;
type Extends<A, B> = [A] extends [B] ? true : false;

// what the client sends must be accepted by the server
export type PatientIn = Assert<Extends<C.Patient, K.Patient>>;
export type InvoiceIn = Assert<Extends<C.InvoiceInput, I.BuildInvoiceInput>>;
export type PaymentIn = Assert<Extends<C.Payment, I.Payment>>;
export type ItemIn = Assert<Extends<C.InvoiceItem, I.InvoiceItem>>;
export type VariantIn = Assert<Extends<C.ReportVariant, K.ReportVariant>>;
export type DesignIn = Assert<Extends<C.ReportDesign, K.ReportDesign>>;
// what the server returns must satisfy the client's types
export type CatalogOut = Assert<Extends<K.TemplateCatalog, C.TemplateCatalog>>;
export type TotalsOut = Assert<Extends<ReturnType<typeof I.invoiceTotalsJson>, C.InvoiceTotals>>;
export type SampleOut = Assert<Extends<K.SampleInfo, C.SampleInfo>>;
```

## File: src/app/new/page.tsx

```ts
"use client";
// FRONTEND page: a result-entry form generated from GET /templates, with a live backend preview.
// Shows how an app builds its own UI on @mgpl-diagnostics/client — the kits never render this form.
import { useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import type { Patient, ReportRequest, ReportVariant, Results, TemplateInfo } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/client";
import { HtmlFrame, useReportHtml, useTemplates, type HtmlFrameHandle } from "@mgpl-diagnostics/client/react";
import { Nav } from "@/components/Nav";
import { openPdf, savePdf } from "@/components/pdf-actions";
import { Segmented } from "@/components/Segmented";
import { mgpl } from "@/lib/mgpl";

const EMPTY_PATIENT: Patient = { title: "Mr", name: "", age: "", sex: "Male", patientId: "", refDoctor: "Self", sampleId: "" };

/** debounce a value so the preview doesn't re-render on every keystroke */
function useDebounced<T>(value: T, ms: number): T {
  const [v, setV] = useState(value);
  useEffect(() => {
    const id = setTimeout(() => setV(value), ms);
    return () => clearTimeout(id);
  }, [value, ms]);
  return v;
}

export default function NewReportPage() {
  const catalog = useTemplates(mgpl);
  const [patient, setPatient] = useState<Patient>(EMPTY_PATIENT);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState<string[]>(["cbc"]);
  const [results, setResults] = useState<Record<string, Results>>({});
  const [variant, setVariant] = useState<ReportVariant>("header");
  const frame = useRef<HtmlFrameHandle>(null);

  // /new?demo fills the form with fictional data (used for screenshots and demos)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).has("demo")) return;
    setPatient({ title: "Mrs", name: "Kavita Sharma", age: "32", sex: "Female", patientId: "MGPL1025", refDoctor: "Self", sampleId: "S2610120398" });
    setSelected(["hb", "blood-sugar"]);
    setResults({ hb: { hb: "10.8" }, "blood-sugar": { bsf: "96", bspp: "182" } });
  }, []);

  const byCategory = useMemo(() => {
    const m = new Map<string, TemplateInfo[]>();
    for (const t of catalog.data?.templates ?? []) m.set(t.category ?? "Other", [...(m.get(t.category ?? "Other") ?? []), t]);
    return [...m.entries()];
  }, [catalog.data]);

  const ready = patient.name.trim() && String(patient.age).trim() && selected.length > 0;
  const request: ReportRequest | null = ready
    ? { patient: { ...patient, age: Number(patient.age) || patient.age }, tests: selected.map((id) => ({ template: id, results: results[id] ?? {} })), variant }
    : null;
  const debounced = useDebounced(request, 600);
  const preview = useReportHtml(mgpl, debounced);

  const setField = (tpl: string, key: string, value: string) => setResults((r) => ({ ...r, [tpl]: { ...r[tpl], [key]: value } }));
  const toggle = (id: string) => setSelected((s) => (s.includes(id) ? s.filter((x) => x !== id) : [...s, id]));
  const p = (k: keyof Patient) => ({
    value: String(patient[k] ?? ""),
    onChange: (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement | HTMLSelectElement>) => setPatient({ ...patient, [k]: e.target.value }),
  });

  return (
    <>
      <Nav active="/new" />
      <div className="app builder">
        <aside className="sidebar form">
          <h2>Patient</h2>
          <div className="grid2">
            <label>
              Title
              <select {...p("title")}>
                {["Mr", "Mrs", "Ms", "Master", "Ku", "Baby"].map((t) => (
                  <option key={t}>{t}</option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </label>
            <label>
              Name
              <input {...p("name")} placeholder="Full name" />
            </label>
            <label>
              Age
              <input {...p("age")} inputMode="numeric" placeholder="Years" />
            </label>
            <label>
              Sex
              <select {...p("sex")}>
                <option>Male</option>
                <option>Female</option>
                <option>Other</option>
              </select>
            </label>
            <label>
              Patient ID
              <input {...p("patientId")} placeholder="MGPL1234" />
            </label>
            <label>
              Sample ID
              <input {...p("sampleId")} />
            </label>
            <label className="wide">
              Ref. doctor
              <input {...p("refDoctor")} />
            </label>
          </div>

          <h2>Tests</h2>
          {catalog.error && <p className="error">{catalog.error.message}</p>}
          {byCategory.map(([cat, tpls]) => (
            <details key={cat} open={cat === "Hematology"}>
              <summary>{cat}</summary>
              {tpls.map((t) => (
                <label key={t.id} className="check">
                  <input type="checkbox" checked={selected.includes(t.id)} onChange={() => toggle(t.id)} /> {t.name}
                </label>
              ))}
            </details>
          ))}

          {selected.map((id) => {
            const t = catalog.data?.templates.find((x) => x.id === id);
            if (!t) return null;
            return (
              <fieldset key={id}>
                <legend>{t.name}</legend>
                {t.fields.map((f) => (
                  <label key={f.key} className="result">
                    <span>{f.label}</span>
                    <input value={String(results[id]?.[f.key] ?? "")} onChange={(e) => setField(id, f.key, e.target.value)} placeholder={Array.isArray(f.range) ? f.range[0] : f.range} />
                    <small>{f.unit}</small>
                  </label>
                ))}
              </fieldset>
            );
          })}
        </aside>

        <main className="main">
          <div className="toolbar">
            <Segmented value={variant} onChange={setVariant} options={[["header", "Header"], ["non-header", "Non-header"]]} label="Variant" />
            <span className="spacer" />
            <button className="btn secondary" disabled={!request} onClick={() => frame.current?.print()}>
              Print
            </button>
            <button className="btn secondary" disabled={!request} onClick={() => request && openPdf(() => mgpl.reports.pdf(request))}>
              Open PDF
            </button>
            <button className="btn" disabled={!request} onClick={() => request && savePdf(() => mgpl.reports.pdf(request), `${patient.patientId || "report"}.pdf`)}>
              Download PDF
            </button>
            <div className="meta">{!request ? "Enter name, age and pick at least one test" : preview.loading ? "rendering…" : "Live preview — rendered by the backend"}</div>
          </div>
          {preview.error && <p className="error">{preview.error.message}</p>}
          <div className="preview">{debounced && preview.data && <HtmlFrame ref={frame} html={preview.data} title="Report preview" />}</div>
        </main>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}
```
